entity-type-id.$comment: Either the entity type name or the entity type's entity id.

anyOf.$comment: A simple string, when no further structure is required.
An array of strings, used when the name consists of multiple parts that need to be kept separate (e.g. a pull request id in a specific repository)
A simple string, used when localization is not needed, interpreted as "default".

A localized string, where the keys are locale names (e.g. "en-US", "fr-FR") and the values are the localized strings for those locales. The "default" key is used as a fallback when a specific locale is not available.
